notes:
Snapshot: SilverQuill is a mid-market SaaS provider for enterprises (customer support platform + KB). Exploring RAG pipeline to reduce ticket volume via deflection and fast in-chat answers. Main ask: accurate top-5 results for user intents and strict latency budget for live agent augmentation.

Key business drivers:
- Reduce tier-1 ticket volume by 30-40% via deflection and bot handle rate.
- Improve agent TTR by surfacing concise top-5 passages and reranked snippets.
- Control per-query cost; procurement comfortable with predictable committed spend (Dedicated).

Technical summary / requirements (from calls):
- Indexing scale: target initial index ~1M documents (support articles, tickets, product KB) with plan to grow to 8-12M over 12 months.
- QPS / latency: peak support chat workload ~220 qps; SLO: end-to-end retrieval + rerank p95 <= 200ms (hard), typical target <150ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target variable cost <= $0.005/query (goal $0.003) at scale; willing to trade small p95 increases for lower cost.
- Retrieval architecture preference: hybrid (sparse + dense) with offline dense embeddings + CPU/GPU lightweight reranker for top-5. Evaluate Redwood's auto-caching and batching.
- Reranker: need high-precision top-5; evaluating candidate approaches: cross-encoder on small GPU pool vs distilled cross-encoder on CPU. Prefer fallback path that uses smaller model when Dedicated capacity is constrained.
- Embedding model preferences: want Redwood-verified open/quantized embeddings, consider 1536-d dense vectors; offline embedding computation acceptable, but incremental embed pipeline for new tickets required.
- Storage & ops: vector index retention policies, efficient shard management, and warm cache for recent topics.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for keys, tenant data residency in NA-only region.
- Legal asked for data processing addendum and confirmation on no external model training with customer data.

Conversations + quotes (shorthand):
- "We need sub-200ms for customer-facing suggestions — anything slower hurts conversion." — Dir. of Product.
- SE call 2026-02-14: validated ingestion pipeline, discussed incremental reindexing and TTL policies.

POC scope (agreed in evaluation):
- Ingest 1M doc subset (KB + 6 months of ticket history).
- Compute embeddings (batch) -> index in Redwood Dedicated candidate pool.
- Run 50k test queries (synthetic + replay) measuring p50/p95/p99 retrieval + rerank times, top-5 nDCG / precision@5.
- Cost model: estimate per-query cost at 1M and 5M index sizes; tradeoffs for quantized embeddings + CPU reranker.
